paragraphs.text: Optional community BaizhiCloud Agent Toolkit MCP configuration bundle for DeepSeek Harness
# BaizhiCloud Agent Toolkit for DeepSeek Harness
An optional community configuration bundle for the hosted BaizhiCloud Agent Toolkit. It loads DSH's
existing MCP client with the service's Streamable HTTP endpoint and an API-key bearer header. It add
s no transport, backend implementation, credential store, or default model provider.
This contribution is part of integration and promotion work for BaizhiCloud Agent Toolkit; it is not
an official DeepSeek integration.
## Requirements
- DeepSeek Harness **0.1.5-rc.2** and pnpm on PATH. The MCP peer dependency is pinned to the tested

release; compatibility with 0.1.6 alpha or later versions has not been established.
- Your own Baizh
iCloud Agent Toolkit account and API key, available as `BAIZHI_API_KEY` in the DSH process environme
nt. Review service pricing before calling tools. Keep the key out of Git, patches, and shared logs.
- An existing DSH profile with the standard tools runtime and network access to `https://agent-toolk
it.app.baizhi.cloud/mcp`.
## Install in your chosen profile
From a reviewed checkout of this bundle:
[代码示例省略，未执行]
Replace `web` with the profile you actually use. DSH installs the package in that profile and adds i
ts declared bundle to the profile's layer list. There is no build or install hook. Package installat
ion alone does not authenticate the hosted service.
Provide `BAIZHI_API_KEY` using your normal environment/secret mechanism, then restart the selected p
rofile. Missing, empty, or whitespace-only values disable this bundle entry, so it makes no connecti
on until a nonempty key is available. A supplied value is trimmed before use in `Authorization: Bear
il a nonempty key is available. A supplied value is trimmed before use in `Authorization: Bearer …`.
The MCP client discovers the service's current tool catalog dynamically. DSH namespaces tools as `mc
p__baizhi__<remote-tool-name>`. Review the actual offered tools and requested operation before appro
ving calls; this bundle does not restrict the service to search/read or promise that every exposed t
bundle does not restrict the service to search/read or promise that every exposed tool is read-only.
A first task after connecting: **Find the official Model Context Protocol transport documentation, r
ead the relevant page, and summarize it with source links.** Success means the tool returned useful
content and the linked sources support the summary. A visible configuration entry, local test, or di
scovered catalog alone is not production acceptance.
## Data, failures, and removal
Tool inputs, including search queries, URLs, and any other approved arguments, are sent to BaizhiClo
ud. Calls may incur charges. This is static API-key bearer authentication, not OAuth. Service access
and tool availability depend on your account.
If tools are absent, check whether the selected profile loaded this bundle and whether its process h
as a nonempty key. Connection/authentication failures do not intentionally stop the rest of the prof
ile (`failOnStartupError: false`); the existing MCP client's reconnect behavior still applies. A 401
requires correcting account/key access, not installing another login wrapper.
To remove it from a profile:
[代码示例省略，未执行]
Restart the profile afterwards. Removing a local bundle does not revoke a remote API key; manage key
s in your BaizhiCloud account.
## Validation and scope
[代码示例省略，未执行]
Six tests use the actual published DSH profile/bundle loader, Cordis lifecycle, tools registry, and
MCP client against a loopback HTTP fixture with synthetic credentials. They cover initialize, tool d
iscovery, registry dispatch, bearer rejection, missing/empty/whitespace credentials, and disposal. T
he test runner isolates HOME and environment; it overrides only the endpoint and reconnect policy in
side the test profile and never calls the production endpoint. Disposal checks stream closure, tool
unregistration, and no reconnect; it does not claim server-side session deletion.
The tests do not exercise a live BaizhiCloud account, model, web UI, production billing, every opera
ting system, or newer DSH releases. The public integration project and this MIT configuration bundle
do not make the hosted backend open source. This is an independent community integration, not an of
ficial DeepSeek endorsement.
